samples.candidate: 这以前是真问题，现在也一样：很聪明的人，也可能给自己挖个很深的坑。然后他说：“太可怕了，千万别碰并发！”别人一听：“哇，他那么聪明，都遇到了麻烦，那我干脆就不试了。”嗯，是啊。
samples.interpretation: Source he has a problem supports 遇到了麻烦 without the stronger inability implication. Both recognizers retain the reaction but have homophone spelling issues for 并发 and 不试; no general recognition or emotional improvement claimed. Keep attributed speech, refusal even to try and understated bridge to unit91; no new speaker or hostile tone assumed.
